# Auto Feed Redux

> Auto Feed Redux is an automated feeding management mod for tamed creatures and animals in valheim. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Self-contained tame feeding automation**: Self-contained tame feeding automation.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal feeding routines or container managers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal feeding routines or container managers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/AutoFeedRedux/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
